note: Questions this corpus CANNOT answer. The corpus is 8 papers: AlexNet 2012, Transformer 2017, BERT 2019, GPT-3 2020, InstructGPT 2022, RAG survey 2023, Llama 3 2024, DeepSeek-R1 2025.

kinds.off_topic: Nothing to do with the papers. Cooking, sport, geography, health.
kinds.near_miss: Uses the papers' own vocabulary but asks for something they never report: a model published after them, a benchmark they never ran, or a component the architecture does not have. These are the hard ones -- they score high on similarity, so the retrieval gate lets them through and the model has to catch them.
kinds.unknowable: No paper could answer it. Future events, opinions, predictions.

questions.question: What is the capital city of France?
How long should I bake sourdough bread?
how much protein should I consume daily for gaining 2 kg of muscle in 2 months?
What is the best recipe for a chocolate cake?
What is the population of Tokyo in 2023?
What is the most effective way to treat depression?
What is the most effective way to prevent heart disease?
What is the latest research on quantum computing?
What reward model did BERT use during RLHF training?
questions.why: BERT predates RLHF entirely. The words are all in the corpus; the combination is not.

questions.question: What was BERT's score on the SuperGLUE leaderboard?
questions.why: The BERT paper reports GLUE (80.5) and SQuAD. SuperGLUE is named but never scored.

questions.question: What was AlexNet's top-5 error rate in the ILSVRC-2015 challenge?
questions.why: The paper is from 2012 and reports ILSVRC-2010 and 2012. A 2015 result cannot be in it.

questions.question: What BLEU score did the Transformer achieve on the WMT 2022 English-to-German task?
questions.why: The paper reports WMT 2014 (28.4 BLEU). A 2022 result cannot exist in a 2017 paper. Replaces an earlier question about a '24-layer Transformer', which was a bad test: BERT-Large in the same corpus IS a 24-layer transformer with 16 heads, so answering it was correct behaviour, not a hallucination.

questions.question: How many parameters does GPT-4 use during pretraining?
questions.why: GPT-3 is in the corpus and GPT-4 is not, so retrieval returns confident, wrong context.

questions.question: How does DeepSeek-R1 perform on the ARC-AGI benchmark?
questions.why: R1 reports AIME, MATH-500, Codeforces and MMLU. ARC-AGI is not among them.

questions.question: What is the context window length of Llama 4?
questions.why: Llama 3 is indexed. The model name differs by one character from something real.

questions.question: Which vision encoder does InstructGPT use for image inputs?
questions.why: InstructGPT is text-only. Llama 3 in the same corpus does have a vision encoder, which makes the wrong answer easy to reach for.

questions.question: What dropout rate did DeepSeek-R1 use in its convolutional layers?
questions.why: R1 has no convolutional layers. AlexNet in the same corpus has both dropout and convolutions.
